findings.comment: "the parameter is contravariant" is partly redundant with the `-E` already visible in the signature. The sentence is redeemed by what follows — explaining the semantic consequence for callers — so this is not a blocker, but trimming to just that consequence would be cleaner: e.g. "the type of exception that may be thrown; a `CanThrow` for a more general exception type also satisfies a requirement for any of its subtypes".
